description: Stops an active JFR recording and saves it to recordings/new_profile.jfr. Use recordings/new_profile.jfr for current data, recordings/old_profile.jfr for previous (before/after comparison).

pid.description: Process ID of the Java process that has the active recording. Must match the pid used in start_profiling.

recordingId.description: ID of the recording to stop. This is the recordingId returned by start_profiling (e.g. '1' or '2').

name: stop_profiling
